about: The errors a hosted MakersMCP gives that no kit says, as a tool result shows them, with <...> for the variable parts. A playbook may quote these; tests/playbooks.test.mjs checks every error a topic quotes against the kits, makersmcp's src and this list. Each entry names where its text is made; MakersMCP-Api's and MakersMCP-Server's tests can keep this list true. Read from MakersMCP-Api origin/main dda51b5 and MakersMCP-Server origin/main de8249b, and the three 429 texts of Kits/Start again from MakersMCP-Api origin/main b416a9a. An entry that names a commit by its subject came with that commit, which was pushed after origin/main bd34f07 and 54ed753, but for those below. The entries from MakersMCP-Api helpers/kits/video-bounds.js and version-holds.js, and run-job.js's sentence for a job with no files to use, are read from its branch feature/hosted-seven-kits at 712f2e2, and MakersMCP-Server's sentences for a start not known and for a wait it could not read from its branch feature/makersmcp-021 at 91bdb9c: the commits they name were not on origin/main on 2026-11-16. The hosted texts that quote them hold once those branches are deployed, so MakersMCP-Server takes this makersmcp only after MakersMCP-Api's branch is live. There a video whose pixels are wider than they are tall counts at the size it is shown, and a length in frames under a video counts only at a given fps: the worker checks as it starts that Inferne-Deploy's run-kit media answers for its test clip as the clip is, each picture's sample_aspect_ratio included, as it does since f83fa44, and holds back the tools whose bounds read what its answer lacks or gives otherwise, caption_video, reframe_video and plan_reframe, and fit_music and analyze_music too, the whole of musicfit, when what it lacks is a stream's kind or a length, or it gives no answer the worker reads. These entries are read again from origin/main once the branches are merged. bounds holds MakersMCP-Api's figures that the numbers of the hosted texts come from.

bounds.about: MakersMCP-Api's figures that the times, lengths and counts of the hosted captions, reframe and music topics come from, read from its branch feature/hosted-seven-kits at 712f2e2, for tests/playbooks.test.mjs to work those numbers out of. From helpers/kits/video-bounds.js: reserveSeconds is RESERVE_SECONDS; captionPixels, reframePixels and outputPixels are CAPTION_PIXELS, REFRAME_PIXELS and OUTPUT_PIXELS; soundSeconds, fitHeldSeconds, fitSeconds and fitShare are SOUND_SECONDS, FIT_HELD_SECONDS, FIT_SECONDS and FIT_SHARE; fitCopies is what fitCopies counts, the fit once and two more with a voice and with a video; fps is the frame rate framesFactor counts every time at, which scales with the frames; times are TIMES, each perPixelSecond times the 2,073,600 pixels of 1920x1080 as the seconds a second of a 1920x1080 video takes, and each grain, the words a refusal gives for footage with grain, as a number; places is PLACES. From helpers/plans/plan-settings.js: jobSeconds is timeoutSeconds's 900, a Free job's time, the shortest job.
